userStories.title: Add getToolsForProfile() to ToolRegistry filtering by allowedProfiles
userStories.description: Single-file change: update src/tools/registry.ts to add a getToolsForProfile(profileId: string) method. This method returns only tools whose allowedProfiles includes the profileId, OR tools with no allowedProfiles (backwards-compatible: untagged tools are available to all profiles). The existing getTools() method stays unchanged for backwards compatibility.
